_about: W05 hand-verified layouts (offsets read in the 2016 WM; names pdb2016, same as the 2017 PDB)

0x0849.name: NC_MISC_SERVER_TIME_NOTIFY_CMD
fields: localtime() at send time (9 × i32: sec, min, hour, mday, mon, year, wday, yday, isdst)
0x0849.notes: 37 bytes. Every 60 s to all in-game clients (inGame +0x704 == 1), first send aligned to the next full minute; once per character login at the first 0x180C (flag +0x1ed00 set by CharDB 0x1007). Client shows it as "%H:%M GMT(+n)" (FUN_0057d8f0)

0x0804.name: NC_MISC_HEARTBEAT_REQ
0x0804.notes: raw 3 bytes 02 04 08; sent once after 30 s without any received packet; no packet within 180 s more → the WM closes the link ("ERROR - HEARTBEAT OVERTIME")

0x441c.name: NC_QUEST_RESET_TIME_CMD
0x441c.notes: 16 bytes, broadcast to all zones at the first main-loop pass after local midnight

0x441d.name: NC_QUEST_RESET_TIME_ZONE_CMD
fields: = charregistnumber of the zone's 0x101C NETPACKETZONEHEADER (the zone puts charNo there)
0x441d.notes: 20 bytes, per character at map login

0x10d9.name: NC_CHAR_CLIENT_NEWBIE_GUIDE_VIEW_LIST_CMD
fields: number of guide ids that follow
guide ids already seen (client keeps ids < 0xC5)
0x10d9.notes: nGuideViewNum + 1 bytes, copied from the CharDB 0x10D8 blob at the first map login (0x180C) of a character; blob freed after a successful send. Struct name PROTO_NC_CHAR_NEWBIE_GUIDE_VIEW_LIST_CMD (pdb2017).
